A.scope: The first inner absent-baseline restoration failure reaches the production full-extension recheck result without an additional restore attempt.
evidence: restoreGuestPreferenceBaseline tags the active operation before each existing operation and, on failure, attaches only its allowlisted diagnostic to the original Error.

runGuestChoicesAcrossExtensionRestarts sanitizes and forwards that diagnostic when its existing restore catch runs; rerunGuestSettingsAfterExtensionReload forwards it through its existing case wrapper; safeGuestFailureDiagnostics serializes it into the case result.

The production rerun fixture injects distinct remove_absent_key and observe_restored_baseline failures and asserts the resulting T04 failure stage, inner stage, error name, safe observations, and absence of injected private text.

The diff adds diagnostic bookkeeping and preserves the existing restoration calls/order. The failing inner restoration is caught and reported; no retry path or extra restoration operation is introduced.
A.native_product_acceptance: UNVERIFIED; this review did not run a native/browser acceptance case or establish the actual failure cause.

evidence: The serializer accepts only enumerated stage/name values and fixed boolean observation fields; the test supplies private strings and an extra token field and confirms none survive serialization.
